fixture: contenteditable





The quick brown fox.




plain text only




editable FROZEN editable






Determinism: the native caret blinks, so two frames of the same page are not
byte-identical while an editor is focused. Load with ?caret=off to set
caret-color: transparent; #caretmark then carries the caret
position instead, and consecutive frames become comparable.




__bg.type(str) inserts text through execCommand('insertText')
(fires the same beforeinput/input pair a real keystroke does) so the editing pipeline can
be exercised without the input transport. __bg.setCaret(n) places the caret at
offset n of the first text node.
